title: review.failed v1
description: A review failed, or a gate failed at task.before_done. Records which criteria (or which rule check) failed and whether the previous builder got a fresh lease.

failed_criterion_ids.description: The criteria the reviewer named as failed; the review criterion when a gate failed.

failed_rule_check_id.description: The rule check whose failure at task.before_done counts as this failed review, or null.

lease_seat_id.description: The builder seat given a fresh lease by this event, or null when it gives none. Replay sets the task's holder from it. Null means the task went to Ready.

wait_cause.description: Why the wait_ready step this event opens is waiting: credential_limit when no seat is eligible only because no candidate is available and none is signed out, else null. Null when the event opens no wait_ready step. Fixed when the step opens (PRD, Rules for steps, rule 8).
